messages.en:
{07 16 00}I'm not having any luck
finding fossils today!

{07 15 00}I guess just picking a spot
in the ground and digging
away won't cut it!
{07 00 00}The only thing I'm
digging up is a whole lot of
boredom, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mul ei vea täna fossiilide
leidmisega!

{07 15 00}Vist ei piisa lihtsalt koha
valimisest maapinnal ja
kaevamisest!
{07 00 00}Ainus asi, mida ma välja
kaevan, on hunnik
igavust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
The {ff 00 00 07}shovel {ff 00 00 00}is a must-have
item when you're out in the
field digging for fossils.
Go crazy with your digging
because, unlike an {ff 00 00 07}axe{ff 00 00 00},
your shovel won't break!
messages.et:
{ff 00 00 07}Labidas {ff 00 00 00}on kohustuslik
asi, kui sa oled väljas
fossiile kaevamas.
Kaeva palju, sest erinevalt
{ff 00 00 07}kirvest{ff 00 00 00} ei lähe su
labidas katki!

messages.en:
If you see a mark on the
ground, whip out your
shovel and dig, dig, dig!
{07 14 00}You never know what you'll
turn up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Kui sa näed maapinnal
märki, võta labidas välja
ja kaeva, kaeva, kaeva!
{07 14 00}Kunagi ei tea, mida sa
välja kaevad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
